title: SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains
abstract: arXiv:2611.08362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models offer parallel text generation, but independently sampling multiple tokens can disrupt their dependencies and change the output distribution. Exact continuous-time sampling avoids this approximation, yet typically requires one sequential model evaluation per token. We introduce SpecCTMC, a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential bottleneck without a separate draft model. SpecCTMC proposes successive token updates using previously computed model predictions, evaluates their intermediate states in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain. It therefore introduces neither time-discretization error nor additional factorization error from parallel decoding. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct

translated_title: SpecCTMC：扩散语言模型连续时间马尔可夫链的精确推测模拟
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型支持并行文本生成，但独立采样多个token可能会破坏它们之间的依赖关系并改变输出分布。精确的连续时间采样可以避免这种近似，但通常需要为每个token进行一次顺序模型评估。我们提出了SpecCTMC，这是一种无需训练的推测采样器，可以在不使用单独草稿模型的情况下减少这种顺序瓶颈。SpecCTMC利用先前计算的模型预测来提出连续的token更新，并行评估这些更新的中间状态，并应用一种精确的接受与修正程序。我们证明SpecCTMC保持了底层连续时间马尔可夫链在事件时间、生成顺序和token值上的联合分布。因此，它既不引入时间离散化误差，也不会因并行解码引入额外的因子分解误差。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-v0-Instruct上的实验
tldr: SpecCTMC提出了一种无需训练、无需草稿模型的推测采样方法，通过并行评估中间状态和精确的接受-修正程序加速扩散语言模型的连续时间采样，并严格证明其保持了原始连续时间马尔可夫链的联合分布。
en_tdlr: SpecCTMC is a training-free speculative sampler that accelerates exact continuous-time sampling for masked diffusion language models without a separate draft model, provably preserving the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain.
